# Polyglot Agent Connectors (codex-cc-agy-grok)

> La passerelle multi-agents ultime et solutions /boost connectant Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, xAI Grok Build, Google Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, Qwen Code et OpenCode. The premier cross-agent bridge and task delegation suite enabling peer-to-peer delegation, adversarial Red Team code reviews, Git-isolated rescue operations, and unified live process supervision with zero credential leakage.

## Core Concepts & /boost Solutions

- **Cross-Agent Bridge (`agent-bridge.mjs`)**: Symmetrical peer-to-peer delegation layer connecting 7 AI coding CLIs with Git scope resolution, worktree isolation, and fail-closed schema verification.
- **Delegation Booster (`run`)**: Delegate bounded subtasks to the most qualified agent without context-switching (e.g., architecture to Claude, deep algorithms to Codex, rapid audits to Grok, plans to Antigravity).
- **Adversarial Red Team Boost (`adversarial-review`)**: Focused multi-model security reviews detecting injection flaws, race conditions, and boundary edge cases.
- **Autonomous Rescue Boost (`rescue`)**: Write-mode self-healing for failing tests with guaranteed zero-loss Git stash rollback (`rollbackRef`).
- **Live Supervision Dashboard (`runs`, `status`)**: Real-time cross-connector monitoring displaying host PIDs, live duration, streaming tokens, and log tails.
- **Zero-Credential Leak Security**: Direct inheritance of local CLI sessions; keys and tokens are never read, stored, or transferred.

## Supported Agent Providers

- **OpenAI Codex** (`plugins/codex-connector`): Native OS sandboxing, JSON Schema file contracts, deep reasoning effort.
- **Claude Code** (`plugins/claude-connector`): Tool allowlist sandboxing, inline JSON Schema, session resumes, USD cost budgets.
- **xAI Grok Build** (`plugins/grok-connector`): Tool allowlist isolation, inline JSON Schema, fast auditing, no-auto-update.
- **Google Antigravity** (`plugins/agy-connector`): Plan mode sandboxing, multi-directory scoping, schema file contracts.
- **GitHub Copilot** (`plugins/copilot-connector`): GitHub CLI tool filtering, inline schema suggestions.
- **Qwen Code** (`plugins/qwen-connector`): Open-source model delegation with tool allowlist isolation.
- **OpenCode** (`plugins/opencode-connector`): Local model orchestration with strict tool permission gating.
